primary_definition_comparison.scope_read: Search-indexed introduction only. It defines the spectral test using a shortest nonzero dual-lattice vector and hyperplanes covering the entire lattice.
primary_definition_comparison.access_limit: Web open returned Anubis access denied; direct download returned HTML. No PDF saved and no full-paper reading claimed.
primary_definition_comparison.query: spectral test finite point set lattice periodic extension hyperplanes definition L Ecuyer
primary_definition_comparison.inference: Supports the standard periodic-lattice interpretation; it does not establish whether Knuth intended the preliminary finite-set wording literally.
